description:
Get an inside look at the world's most powerful X-ray laser at SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory in Stanford, which scientists use to film movies of molecules.

Read more about the SLAC National Accelerator Labratory on CNET.com
See SLAC, a two-mile particle accelerator next to Stanford https://zdcs.link/z3KDZ3

0:00 - Introduction to SLAC & LCLS
0:48 - Upgrading the Particle Accelerator
1:45 - How Cryomodules Work
2:23 - Cooling Below Outer Space Temperatures
3:11 - Generating Hard X-Rays
4:15 - Filming "Molecular Movies" of Atoms
5:03 - Real-World Applications & Future Experiments
